obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be covered by flesh and skin composed of synthetic rubber sheets (R1, R2) and neoprene sheets (N1F, N2F, N1T, N2T, N3) as shown in Figure 1
obligations.ears: For each test, the impactor (femur, knee joint and tibia) shall be covered by flesh and skin composed of synthetic rubber sheets (R1, R2) and neoprene sheets (N1F, N2F, N1T, N2T, N3) as shown in Figure 1.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be within the requirements described in Figure 1
obligations.ears: The size of the sheets shall be within the requirements described in Figure 1.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: The compression characteristics shall be checked using material from the same batch as the sheets used for the impactor flesh and skin
obligations.ears: The compression characteristics shall be checked using material from the same batch as the sheets used for the impactor flesh and skin.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be stored for a sufficient period of time in a controlled storage area with a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for testing
obligations.ears: Prior to impactor removal for testing, all impactor components shall be stored for a sufficient period of time in a controlled storage area with a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area as defined in Annex 3, paragraph 1.1.
obligations.ears: After removal from the storage, the impactor shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area as defined in Annex 3, paragraph 1.1.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area
obligations.ears: When the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area, each test shall be completed within two hours.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation
obligations.ears: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury
obligations.ears: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: Tests shall be to different types of structure
obligations.ears: Where types of structure vary throughout the area to be assessed, tests shall be to different types of structure.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle
obligations.ears: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

obligations.response: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report
obligations.ears: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle
obligations.ears: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be ±2° at the time of first contact
obligations.ears: At the time of first contact, the tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ±2°.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ±2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane
obligations.ears: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ±2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
